xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3842: Warn when a tiered-execution tier is configured with a model unsuited to that tier

plan.title: Warn when a tiered-execution tier is configured with a model unsuited to that tier
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

narratives.Problem: PAN-3836 ran a 14-item feature on claude-haiku-4-5 because its first xBRIEF item was rated simple and the trivial-simple tier mapped to haiku; six review cycles followed. The tier-table loader validates model ids, harnesses, and ToS policy but has no notion of model capability, pan doctor never inspects tiered_execution at all, the Settings crew row shows only the PAN-1865 harness badge, and the spawn paths log nothing about fit. Nothing told the operator the mapping was risky before an issue paid for it.
narratives.Proposal: Add a capability-class table (frontier / workhorse / small) beside the model catalog with a completeness test, and one pure checker (checkTierFitness) that turns a tier table plus a context object into structured, never-blocking warnings: underpowered, overpowered (cost), unknown-model, provider-not-enabled, supervisor-underpowered. Surface the same checker in three places: a pan doctor row (which also validates the loader and, when tiered execution is off, checks the implicit roles.work tier), a badge on each affected crew row and the supervisor block in Settings computed from the unsaved draft, and one [spawn] tier fitness: log line per work-agent spawn. The single-work spawn check compares the staffed model against the maximum difficulty across all pending plan items, which is the check that would have caught PAN-3836. Full detail, class table, bands, message templates, and before/after snippets are in .pan/drafts/PAN-3842.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No hard error for any fitness condition; warnings never block save or spawn (D8)
- No harness-subagent capability table or check; the code enum reserves 'harness-unverified' only (D7)
- No per-provider API-key probing; the credential signal is config.enabledProviders / models.providers (D6)
- No reconciliation of the frontend modelCatalog.ts tier field with the class table (D12, hazard H3)
- No change to tier resolution in resolve-tier.ts or staffing.ts; the single-work path still staffs from the first dispatchable item and this issue only warns about it
- No dashboard banner or notification for the spawn-time warning; it is a log line only
- No pan doctor --strict promotion of fitness warnings to errors

autoDecisions.summary: Class table lives in its own pure module src/lib/model-capability-class.ts, importing only MODEL_DEPRECATIONS.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a table beside the catalog; model-capabilities.ts imports effect and would break the direct frontend import that lets Settings check the unsaved draft.

autoDecisions.summary: Class assignments and difficulty bands are fixed in PRD sections 5.1 and 5.2.
autoDecisions.rationale: prd-authoring rule: the executor must not make judgment calls; the completeness test catches any id the table misses.

autoDecisions.summary: Overpowered fires only when every owned difficulty caps below the model's class.
autoDecisions.rationale: A tier owning trivial through medium on Opus is a legitimate choice; medium allows frontier.

autoDecisions.summary: Credential check uses config.enabledProviders (server) and models.providers (frontend).
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the one canonical provider-usable signal already exposed by the settings GET; API keys live in three fragmented sources and getProviderAuthMode returns undefined for most providers.
HarnessBehavior has no subagent field and no code records the fact; inventing it violates facts-not-guessing. canUseHarnessSync hard errors and the PAN-1865 badge already cover the verifiable subset.

autoDecisions.summary: Single-work spawn compares the staffed class against the plan's maximum pending difficulty.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's listed heuristics alone would not flag simple->haiku (that is the intended mapping); the incident was the whole issue running on the first item's tier.

autoDecisions.summary: When tiered execution is off, doctor checks the implicit roles.work tier as pseudo-tier 'default' owning all difficulties.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names 'a role model that feeds a tier'; PAN-2397 makes roles.work the implicit tier.

autoDecisions.summary: Frontend badges reuse the existing amber PAN-1865 span styling and sit on the crew row, not in a section-level banner.
autoDecisions.rationale: Style guide forbids new colors; the row already names the crew so the path prefix is stripped from the badge text.

items.title: Add the model capability-class table module with a catalog completeness test

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/model-capability-class.ts exporting ModelCapabilityClass, MODEL_CAPABILITY_CLASSES (copy PRD section 5.1 verbatim), and capabilityClassOf(modelId) which resolves through MODEL_DEPRECATIONS first. Import only MODEL_DEPRECATIONS from ./model-deprecations.js; never import model-capabilities.ts, fs, path, or effect. Write src/lib/__tests__/model-capability-class.test.ts with the five cases in PRD WI-1: every PROVIDERS[*].models id has a class, every non-deprecated MODEL_CAPABILITIES key has a class (same filter as settings-model-catalog.ts:58-59), a deprecated alias resolves to its replacement's class, an opencode/ id returns undefined, and the module's source text contains no node or effect import. If the completeness test names an id the table misses, classify it by the PRD rule of thumb and add it to both the module and PRD 5.1 in the same commit.

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/agents/tier-fitness.ts exporting CAPABILITY_CLASS_RANK and DIFFICULTY_CLASS_BANDS (PRD 5.2), the TierFitnessCode / TierFitnessWarning / TierFitnessContext types and message templates (PRD 5.3), the structural TierFitnessConfig input, checkTierFitness(config, ctx), and checkStaffingFitness(staffing, difficulties, ctx). Implement the per-entry algorithm in PRD WI-2 exactly: unknown-model short-circuits band checks, provider-not-enabled only when ctx.enabledProviders is defined, unclassified models stop after the provider check, underpowered lists only the offending difficulties, overpowered only when every owned difficulty caps below the class, supervisor-underpowered when the supervisor class is small. narrative.Action: Create src/cli/commands/doctor-tier-fitness.ts exporting checkTierFitnessConfig(deps) as written in PRD WI-4 with an injectable loadConfig. Warnings become status 'warn' with messages joined by newline plus four spaces and the FIX text from the PRD; otherwise 'ok'. Register it in doctorCommand with checks.push(checkTierFitnessConfig()) directly after checks.push(checkOrphanProposedSpecs()) at src/cli/commands/doctor.ts:855.
